rationale.consistency: Perfectly matches codebase conventions, including idiomatic Git client copying and import aliasing for shared packages.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles empty paths, mutually exclusive flags, existing branches, and worktree reuse edge cases gracefully.
rationale.scope: Implements exactly what was requested without unrelated refactoring, correctly centralizing worktree logic.
rationale.readability: Clear names, well-structured logic, and self-documenting git operations make it very easy to follow.
rationale.robustness: Correctly validates paths, handles Git command failures safely, and properly isolates worktree operations via client copies.
rationale.maintainability: Extracting worktree resolution and Git commands into the shared package significantly improves cross-command maintainability.
